title: Base architecture and shared registries
brief: BaseRepository + interface, RepositoryServiceProvider (name-convention binding), BaseService, BaseDTO, ApiError and exception handler with code + request_id, RequestId middleware, routes/web.php loading routes/features/*.php, OrderedSeeder + DatabaseSeeder discovery.

title: Identity schema
brief: Migrations, models, factories, enums: users (status enum active/non_active/suspend/banned), roles, permissions, user_roles, role_permissions. UUID PKs, soft deletes, indexes, FKs.

title: Content schema
brief: Migrations, models, factories: categories, tags, articles (status enum), article_tags, article_images, comments (parent_id), products (books), product_categories.

title: Operations schema
brief: Migrations, models, factories: contacts, menus, settings, audit_logs, system_logs, otp_codes.

title: Query kit
brief: Reusable QueryParams DTO and whitelist applier (search, filters, sort, offset, limit, date range) usable by every repository, with unit tests.

title: Core seeders
brief: RolesSeeder, permission arrays per resource, default role-permission map, dev accounts for the five roles, all via OrderedSeeder.

title: Register, login, logout
brief: Services, DTOs, FormRequests and Fortify wiring for register, login, logout; throttling and session invalidation.

title: OTP service and forgot flows
brief: OTP service (hashed, expiring, single use, rate limited); forgot email and forgot password flows built on it.

title: Password reset and email verification
brief: Password reset after OTP, email verification, password rules Validator.

title: User status guard
brief: Middleware enforcing non_active, suspend, banned on every authenticated request, with forced logout.

title: Authorization service
brief: AuthorizationService: hasRole, hasAnyRole, hasPermission, hasAnyPermission, canManageResource; role and permission repositories.

title: Permission middleware and policies
brief: Permission middleware, base policies with ownership rules, protected system roles.

title: Menu registry
brief: MenuRegistry as single source discovering app/Support/Menu/Items/*Menu.php, canAccessMenu, default menu permissions.

title: User administration
brief: User CRUD service: status changes, soft delete and restore, whitelisted listing.

title: Role assignment workflow
brief: Guest requests writer role, admin approves or rejects; super_admin manages admin-writer and admin-product.

title: Roles and permissions admin
brief: Custom role and permission CRUD, permission assignment, system role protection.

title: Audit trail
brief: AuditLogService plus trait or listener recording actor, target, action, before/after for every admin mutation.

title: Profile
brief: Profile update limited to safe fields; privileged fields blocked.

title: Articles core
brief: Article CRUD, slug generation with collision handling, Markdown storage with sanitized rendering.

title: Article workflow
brief: draft -> submitted -> published/suspended/removed with timestamps and actor, ownership rules, server-side status filtering.

title: Article images and tags
brief: Image upload (MIME, size, generated names) and tag sync.

title: Nested comments
brief: Nested comments, moderation, soft delete.

title: Products (books)
brief: Book CRUD: slug, ISBN, price, featured, publish/unpublish, images.

title: Categories
brief: Category CRUD and attaching categories and tags to products.

title: About and Home content
brief: About CMS content and configurable Home sections.

title: Contacts
brief: Public contact submission with rate limiting; admin statuses new, read, replied, archived.

title: Analytics queries
brief: Date range, presets, day/week/month grouping using SQL aggregates only.

title: Logs and monitoring
brief: Log and error listing with level and request_id filters; safe system information service.

title: Settings
brief: Settings model by category; menu settings listing names from MenuRegistry.

title: Security hardening
brief: Security headers middleware, upload validation review, rate limit review, index review.

title: Docs and release
brief: README (install, env, migrate, seed, test, build, RBAC model, dev credentials dev-only, deployment) and .env.example.
